科研时效、社区决定权与数据合规之间，如何形成各方愿意遵守的合作规则？: How can research timeliness, community decision-making and data compliance become rules every party is willing to follow?
建立兼顾预警能力、当地数据主权与患者权益的合作网络。: Build a collaboration network that balances early warning, local data sovereignty and patient rights.
提高跨国预警的时效与模型质量。: Improve the timeliness and quality of cross-border early-warning models.
更新过慢会错过早期信号。: Slow updates may miss early signals.
合作不能完全失去跨地区分析能力。: Collaboration must retain cross-region analysis capacity.
可以不传输原始数据，协商汇总更新频率。: Negotiate aggregate-update frequency without transferring raw data.
让当地患者和社区获得实际收益。: Deliver practical benefits to local patients and communities.
数据被再次利用，社区失去决定权。: Data reuse may deprive communities of decision-making power.
未经授权，原始患者数据不跨境。: Raw patient data must not cross borders without authorization.
可分享最小必要汇总信息，但需社区复审。: Share the minimum necessary aggregates, subject to community review.
紧急访问缺乏记录和明确权限。: Emergency access lacks records and clear permissions.
不能绕过审批、访问留痕和用途限制。: Approvals, access logs and purpose restrictions cannot be bypassed.
可以简化紧急审批，但必须限时并事后复审。: Simplify emergency approval if access is time-limited and reviewed afterward.
如何兼顾预警时效与当地处理能力？: How can timely warnings match local processing capacity?
哪些信息可共享？谁决定用途与撤回？: What may be shared? Who controls purposes and withdrawal?
谁触发紧急访问？审批、期限和复审如何安排？: Who triggers emergency access, and how are approval, expiry and review arranged?
学生策划者、文化社团与校园管理方，如何兼顾表达空间、公平参与与场地秩序？: How can student organizers, cultural groups and campus administrators balance expression, fair participation and venue order?
让不同文化都能被尊重地呈现，共同办一场可参与、可持续的校园文化节。: Present each culture respectfully and jointly run an inclusive, sustainable campus festival.
吸引更多同学参与，按期完成文化节。: Attract more students and complete the festival on schedule.
节目协调过慢，预算和筹备时间不足。: Slow coordination and limited budget or preparation time.
不能无限追加预算或临时取消主要活动。: The budget cannot expand indefinitely; major events cannot be cancelled at the last minute.
可调整舞台时段，把部分活动转为小型交流。: Adjust stage slots or turn some events into small-group exchanges.
让少数文化也有平等表达和自我介绍的机会。: Give minority cultures equal opportunities to express and introduce themselves.
文化被猎奇化，热门社团挤占全部时段。: Cultures may be exoticized while popular groups occupy all slots.
未经同意不能改写社团介绍或使用有争议的符号。: Group introductions and disputed symbols cannot be changed or used without consent.
愿意共用展位和轮换演出，但须保留内容审核权。: Share booths and rotate performances while retaining content-review rights.
保障场地秩序、可达性及周边师生正常作息。: Protect venue order, accessibility and the daily routines of nearby students and staff.
人员拥挤、噪声和临时搭建带来风险。: Crowding, noise and temporary structures create risks.
不能占用疏散通道或超过学校批准的活动时段。: Do not block evacuation routes or exceed approved event hours.
可在评估后延长白天使用时间并提供替代场地。: Extend daytime use after assessment and provide alternative venues.
热门活动与小众文化如何公平分配舞台、预算和展位？: How should popular events and minority cultures share stage time, budget and booths fairly?
谁确认介绍内容？如何处理不同理解与文化禁忌？: Who confirms introductions? How are different interpretations and cultural sensitivities handled?
如何协调活动体验、噪声限制和人员疏散？: How can the event experience respect noise limits and evacuation needs?
确认各社团参与时段: Confirm participation slots for each group
复核文化介绍与展示内容: Review cultural introductions and display content
居民、沿街商户与街区管理方，对同一片公共空间有不同期待，如何共同制定使用规则？: Residents, local businesses and district administrators have different expectations of the same public space. How can they set shared rules?
保留街区生活与经营活力，让公共空间对不同年龄和需求的人都友好。: Preserve neighborhood life and business activity while welcoming people of different ages and needs.
获得安静、可休息并适合老人儿童的公共空间。: Provide a quiet resting space suitable for older people and children.
夜间噪声、占道经营影响日常生活。: Night noise and commercial obstruction disrupt daily life.
不能堵住住宅入口、无障碍路线或影响夜间休息。: Do not block residential entrances or accessible routes, or disturb nighttime rest.
可接受规定时段的小型市集与共享座椅。: Allow small markets and shared seating at agreed times.
保留合理经营机会，让街区更有吸引力。: Preserve reasonable business opportunities and neighborhood appeal.
统一改造增加成本，取消外摆影响生意。: Uniform redesign raises costs; removing outdoor displays harms trade.
不能不经沟通就长期取消全部展示和经营空间。: Do not permanently remove all display and trading space without consultation.
愿意限制外摆范围、共同清洁，并试行安静时段。: Limit outdoor displays, share cleaning duties and try quiet hours.
在有限预算内改善公共设施和通行秩序。: Improve facilities and circulation within a limited budget.
责任不清导致设施失修，规则无法持续执行。: Unclear responsibility leads to poor maintenance and unenforceable rules.
公共通行和紧急通道必须保持畅通。: Public circulation and emergency routes must stay clear.
可先做可逆的试点，再依据反馈调整布局。: Start with a reversible pilot, then adjust the layout using feedback.
休息区、通行区与经营区怎样划分？: How should resting, circulation and trading areas be divided?
怎样兼顾居民作息和商户经营？: How can residents' routines coexist with business operations?
谁收集反馈、维护设施并决定是否调整试点？: Who collects feedback, maintains facilities and decides whether to adjust the pilot?
共同核对通行与休息区布局: Check the circulation and resting-area layout together
安排试点评估与反馈窗口: Schedule pilot evaluation and a feedback window

学生策划组编制安排，文化社团代表核对参与机会与介绍内容，校园管理方核对场地限制。: Student organizers prepare the schedule; cultural representatives check participation and introductions; campus administrators check venue limits.
仅使用已批准的白天活动时段，不占用疏散通道，不追加既定预算。: Use approved daytime hours, keep evacuation routes clear and stay within the agreed budget.
在保留各方不同需求的前提下，形成公平、安全且可以复核的文化节安排。: Create fair, safe and reviewable festival arrangements while preserving different needs.
本次校园文化节已批准的白天活动；不涉及新增预算或其他活动授权。: Approved daytime activities for this campus festival; no additional budget or authority for other events.
文化表达细节、场地安排与资源分配中未纳入共同条款的内容仍待协商。: Cultural details, venue arrangements and resource allocations outside the shared clauses remain open for negotiation.
小众社团也需要基本舞台时间，不能仅按报名人数分配机会。: Minority groups need basic stage time too. Opportunities cannot depend only on registration numbers.
回应基本展示机会，增加轮换分配与共同复审。: Protect basic presentation opportunities through rotation and joint review.
优先把舞台时段分配给报名人数最多的社团，其他社团安排在展位展示。: Give stage slots first to the largest groups; let other groups present at booths.
每个报名社团至少获得一个20分钟展示时段，剩余时段通过轮换分配；社团自行确认介绍: Give each registered group at least one 20-minute slot and allocate remaining time by rotation. Each group confirms its own introduction.
排期覆盖全部报名社团，每个社团至少有一个20分钟时段，且不超出批准时段。: The schedule includes every registered group, with at least one 20-minute slot each, within approved hours.
由学生策划组统一改写社团介绍，统一展示风格后直接发布。: Student organizers rewrite all group introductions in a uniform style and publish them directly.
每个社团自行确认介绍文字和展示符号；存在争议时先暂停该内容，由社团代表与策划组共: Each group confirms its introduction and symbols. Pause disputed content until representatives and organizers jointly revise and confirm it.
每份介绍均有所属社团的确认记录，争议内容在修订确认前不发布。: Every introduction has its group's confirmation record. Disputed content stays unpublished until revisions are confirmed.
为了吸引更多观众，把所有节目集中到晚间主舞台。: Concentrate all performances on the evening main stage to attract a larger audience.
节目安排在批准的白天时段，设置轮换场地、观众容量和疏散路线；管理方核对后公布时间: Schedule performances within approved daytime hours, with rotating venues, capacity limits and evacuation routes. Administrators check the timetable before publication.
活动时间在批准范围内，容量与疏散路线经管理方核对，替代场地安排完整。: Event times are approved; administrators checked capacity and evacuation routes; alternative venues are fully arranged.
研究团队编制汇总预警计划，医院与社区核对授权与当地能力，数据合规方核对用途、期限: Researchers prepare aggregate-warning plans; hospital/community representatives check authorization and local capacity; compliance representatives check purpose, expiry and access logs.
彩排仅使用虚构汇总数据，不涉及真实患者记录；原始患者数据不跨境，不绕过审批与访问: Use fictional aggregate data only. No real patient records, cross-border raw data or bypassed approval/access logging.
兼顾预警时效、当地社区决定权与可审计的数据合作机制。: Balance warning timeliness, local decision-making and auditable data collaboration.
虚构跨国预警协作试点的汇总信息与流程验证；不授权真实数据传输。: Fictional aggregate data and process testing in a cross-border warning pilot; no authorization to transfer real data.
未纳入共同条款的数据用途、紧急触发条件和长期共享频率仍待各方协商。: Data purposes, emergency triggers and long-term sharing frequency outside the shared clauses remain open for negotiation.
小时级上报超出当地处理能力，社区需要授权和复审汇总共享的机会。: Hourly reporting exceeds local capacity. Communities need authorization and review rights for aggregate sharing.
回应当地能力与社区授权，改为每日最小必要汇总更新并共同复审。: Respect local capacity and authorization through daily minimum aggregates and joint review.
要求所有合作单位每小时上传一次预警汇总，以研究团队时效需求为优先。: Require every partner to upload warning aggregates hourly, prioritizing research timeliness.
常态每日提交一次经当地授权的最小必要汇总；出现约定阈值信号时走限时紧急审批，不共: Share authorized minimum aggregates once daily. Threshold signals use time-limited emergency approval; raw patient records are not shared.
常态汇总频率为每日一次，字段经过当地授权；模拟紧急请求具有限时审批与留痕，原始记: Daily aggregate fields are locally authorized. Simulated emergency requests have time-limited approval and logs. Raw records do not cross borders.
研究团队可自行决定汇总信息的后续用途，合作单位不能撤回。: The research team may decide later uses of aggregate information alone, and partners cannot withdraw.
用途与共享字段由当地医院和社区先确认；新增用途须重新授权，撤回请求停止后续共享并: Local hospitals and communities confirm purposes and fields first. New purposes need renewed authorization; withdrawal stops future sharing and retains handling records.
每项用途与共享字段都有模拟授权记录，新增用途重新确认，撤回演练有停止共享和处理记: Every purpose and field has a simulated authorization record. New purposes are reconfirmed, and withdrawal drills record stopped sharing and handling.
研究团队发现异常即可无限期扩大访问权限，事后再告知其他方。: Researchers may expand access indefinitely after detecting an anomaly and notify others afterward.
三方共同确认触发阈值；异常请求经指定审批人批准后限时生效，自动到期并保留访问记录: All parties agree on triggers. A designated approver authorizes time-limited access; it expires automatically, is logged and receives joint review afterward.
模拟异常请求包含共同触发条件、审批人、到期时间、访问记录和事后复审结果。: Simulated anomaly requests include agreed triggers, an approver, expiry, access logs and post-event review results.
居民代表核对休息与通行需求，商户代表提交外摆和清洁安排，街区管理方核对公共通行并: Residents check rest and circulation needs; businesses submit outdoor-display and cleaning plans; administrators check access and organize a reversible pilot.
